title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-28
lineage: SBD > Master PCM > DAT/0 > Sony R500 > SEK'D Prodif Plus > Samplitude Professional v7.02 > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Solid late‑'82 soundboard capture of a fiery Shakedown with strong playing, though the lack of transition between On the Road Again and Touch of Grey hurts the flow.
ai_review.review: The recording is a decent late‑1982 board offering clear, well‑balanced sound that many reviewers rate around 3½–4 stars. Musically the show shines on the Shakedown – described as smoking, edgy, and a highlight of the set – but suffers from a missing transition between On the Road Again and Touch of Grey and an abrupt jump into Samson.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance (especially Shakedown) and rate the sound quality as good for a late‑'82 board; one very negative review pulls the overall sentiment toward mixed, yielding an average around 4.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as "ok sound" and "excellent for a late '82 board" with clarity typical of that era; no major drop‑outs noted, though some listeners sense the tape runs slightly fast.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Missing transition between On the Road Again and Touch of Grey detracts from continuity; an abrupt shift into Samson is noted but overall set feels juicy and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for edgy, lyrical improvisation on Shakedown, but also called out for a flubbed lyric line that some find sad or amusing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for a humorous vocal stumble into Samson, adding "giggles" to the performance.
